title: Halt hears radio reports of beams into weapons storage area
summary: Robert Hastings tells of Halt hears radio reports of beams into weapons storage area, about December 1980 (interviewed 2005) at RAF Bentwaters weapon storage area, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he heard on the radio that he had that security policeman back at the the weapon storage area were reporting an object hovering above the weapon storage area sending down beams of light

plain: Robert Hastings, a researcher who collects accounts of UFOs at nuclear bases, tells what Charles Halt, a US Air Force officer, told him in a 2005 interview about December 1980 at RAF Bentwaters, a British air base used by the US Air Force. Hastings says Halt heard on his radio that security police at the base's weapons storage area were reporting an object hovering overhead and sending down beams of light. If true, it would mean something was taking an interest in stored weapons.
